ai_summary: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited has injected Rs. 10 Crores into its wholly-owned NBFC subsidiary, Aeroflex Finance Private Limited, to support the subsidiary's working capital, capex, and business expansion in tech-enabled lending. This significant capital infusion aims to capitalize on the subsidiary's recent substantial turnover growth in FY2025-26; however, previous year's financial volatility suggests a need for careful oversight of its performance.
